mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the past month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which negatively impacts consumer spending and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which positively impacts the broader economy and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in the past month signals a loosening monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it indicates strong consumer demand, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strengthening labor market, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 4%, it indicates a strong economy with accommodative monetary policy, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: expansionary economic phase with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
